name: mistral-ocr-nextcloud
description: Build tooling for the ExApp's browser bundles. AppAPI injects them as classic scripts/styles, so the built files are committed.

scripts.build: npm run build:files && npm run build:admin
scripts.build:admin: esbuild js/src/admin_page.js --bundle --format=iife --target=es2020 --minify --alias:vue=vue/dist/vue.esm-browser.prod.js --outfile=js/admin_page.js && mkdir -p css && mv js/admin_page.css css/admin.css
scripts.check: npm run build && git diff --exit-code js/files_action.js js/admin_page.js css/admin.css
